rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a standalone half or one of two equal parts.

example.english: I've already drawn half of this picture.
example.traditional: 呢幅畫我已經畫咗一半。
example.jyutping: ni1 fuk1 waa2 ngo5 ji5 ging1 waa2 zo2 jat1 bun3

rows.note: Use this shorter form especially before a classifier, measure word, or time unit, as in 半個蘋果.

example.jyutping: ngo5 sik6 zo2 bun3 go3 ping4 gwo2

rows.note: Use 半 as the compact modifier for something partial or incomplete, such as 半熟 or 半透明.

example.jyutping: bun3 suk6 ge3 daan6 ngo5 m4 sik6

rows.note: Use 差唔多 as the all-purpose spoken choice for “almost” or “nearly.”

example.english: Almost half the people have arrived.
example.jyutping: caa1 m4 do1 jat1 bun3 jan4 dou3 zo2

rows.note: Use 差啲 for a near miss, where something almost happened but usually did not.

example.english: I was half a second away from missing the bus.
example.jyutping: ngo5 caa1 di1 gon2 m4 cit3 baan1 ce1 laa3

rows.jyutping: jat1 bun3 jat1 bun3 gam2 V
rows.note: Use this pattern when an action is carried out in two equal parts or divided equally.

example.english: We split the cake half and half.
example.traditional: 我哋一半一半咁分份蛋糕。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jat1 bun3 jat1 bun3 gam2 fan1 fan6 daan6 gou1
